probes.name: p11-valid-precision-mix
probes.rationale: Rewrites every numeric field as an alternating mix of 17-significant-digit fixed and scientific decimal literals, each verified programmatically to round-trip bit-identically to the saved double (the reference decimals are full double-precision representations, so 17 digits are sufficient), and reverses the column order in every file. import csv
for p in ('hrv_time.csv','hrv_freq.csv','hrv_nonlinear.csv','hrv_indices.csv'):
    rows=list(csv.reader(open(p,newline='',encoding='utf-8')))

    h,d=rows;n=[]
    for i,v in enumerate(d):
        if v=='':n.append('')

            x='%.17g'%float(v);assert float(x)==float(v),(v,x);n.append(x)
        else:
            x='%.17e'%float(v);assert float(x)==float(v),(v,x);n.append(x)
    rh,rd=h[::-1],n[::-1]
    f=open(p,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8')
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(rh);w.writerow(rd);f.close()
    rows2=list(csv.reader(open(p,newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
    assert set(rows2[0])==set(h) and len(rows2)==2
print('OK')
